thread:
Alana: opened PR with draft examples for audit-log pseudonymization + SOC2-friendly retention wording. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462 — looking for legal + infra review.
Mike: quick skim, left a tiny nit re: 'customer-identifiable' vs 'tenant-identifying'. otherwise looks good. :thumbsup:
Devon: can we add a short curl export snippet showing redaction? e.g. ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -X POST \n  -d '{ \"redact\": true }' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export
```
Priya: legal prefers explicit "tenant data" / "user data" separation. also avoid vague phrasing like 'up to X days' for retention; give concrete TTL examples (e.g., 180 days) or point to policy.
Sam (docs): pushed a commit addressing Mike's nit and added Devon's curl snippet plus a JSON pseudonym example: ```json
{\"user_id\": \"pseud_XXXX\", \"action\": \"login\"}
```
Alana: thanks — Priya can you confirm SOC2 wording? current sentence: 'Audit logs may contain tenant identifiers required for incident investigation; these identifiers are pseudonymized when exported for analytics.'
Priya: suggest reword: 'Audit logs may include tenant identifiers for operational troubleshooting. When exporting logs for analytics or shared reporting, these identifiers are pseudonymized or removed per customer configuration.' aligns better with SOC2 control language.
Mike: also note SDK parity — we use `redwood.audit.export(..., redact=true)` in python examples. Sam, can you add matching JS + Py snippets so docs are consistent?
Sam (docs): will do. I also noticed a broken link to the audit export API in the previous doc — fixed and added an anchor.
Devon: can we add a short migration note explaining how existing customers can opt into pseudonymization and a sample Terraform change (audit block) so infra knows how to flip the flag?
Alana: yes — and a one-liner CLI for re-scrubbing historical exports would be helpful. Sam, can you add migration stub + CLI example?
Sam (docs): added migration stub and TODO for infra to confirm rollout window. request ack from infra here — @Mike?
Mike: ack from infra. note: exports could be long-running; will schedule a gradual rollout and communicate maintenance window.
compliance-bot: Automated check — PR 462 missing SOC2 control mapping table. Please add mapping or mark as non-applicable.
Sam (docs): adding mapping table now, thanks bot.
Alana: plan: merge after Priya's final signoff + infra ack. aiming for EOD. :pray:
Priya: legal sign-off, one punctuation nit fixed. :white_check_mark:
Mike: infra ack in thread, looks good to me.
Sam (docs): merged PR and closed branch. thanks everyone! :tada:
